name: Shell Completions
description: Generates zsh, bash, and fish completions for CLIs installed by other features, at build time and again on create

commands.description: Comma-separated CLIs to generate completions for. 'auto' is every known CLI on PATH: just, kubectl, helm, minikube, uv, docker, gh, rg, fd, codex. Unknown names use '<cli> completion <shell>'.

shells.description: Comma-separated shells to write completions for: zsh, bash, fish.
